mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced economic activity and lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS rate increased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the potential economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE increased by more than 0.3 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 declined for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side of the economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate higher corporate earnings.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 60% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate a broader economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 5% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decline for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate a broader economic slowdown.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5% and PAYEMS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE was above 5% and PAYEMS declined for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 2% for two consecutive quarters and the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a demand-constrained economy with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate lower corporate earnings.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2% for 2 quarters and FEDFUNDS > 4%
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns of the S&P 500 are positive in more than 50% of the instances where GDPC1 growth was below 2% for two consecutive quarters and FEDFUNDS was above 4%.
